purpose: Separate the important stages and their boundaries while retaining a complete textual path.
alt: Fix task input/quality, run the application and verify the result. In parallel record the full timeline and device costs, then use profiling to explain differences. Quality and execution evidence share one retained contract.

purpose: One trace, three latency questions. Latent Light derivation from the illustrative timestamps above; no measured device results and no assumption of equal individual gaps.
